product: A calm, focused design system for clear editorial product interfaces.
audience: Product teams and end users who value readable, low-noise interfaces during focused work.

foundations.accentDirection: muted botanical green used for actions, selection, and reassurance
foundations.contrast: light surfaces with readable dark ink and measured accent contrast
foundations.typographyCharacter: refined sans-serif with an ink-led editorial hierarchy
foundations.dominantRadius: soft small-to-medium corners with occasional generous card corners
foundations.surfaceModel: warm white surfaces over a pale canvas, with muted fills for quiet grouping
foundations.elevation: subtle shadows reserved for raised cards, menus, and dialogs
